title: Topic 35 | Basic concepts of the molecular kinetic theory (MKT)

questions.text: Which answer states the basic postulates of the molecular kinetic theory most completely?
answers: any body is made of molecules, they are in random motion, and interaction forces act between them.
matter consists of tiny particles, and interaction forces act between them.
matter consists of tiny pieces that fill space continuously.
matter consists of elementary particles that continuously transform into one another.

questions.text: 1 mol is the unit of which quantity in the SI?
What is the unit of the amount of substance?
What physical quantity is called Avogadro's number?
answers: the number of atoms in 12 g of carbon.
1/12 of the mass of one carbon atom.
the mass of 1 mole of a substance.
the ratio of the mass of one atom to 1/12 of the mass of a carbon atom.

questions.text: The relative atomic mass of copper is 64 amu. Find the mass of one copper atom (kg). 1 amu = 1.67 · 10⁻²⁷ kg.
The mass of one gold atom is 3.29 · 10⁻²⁵ kg. Find its relative atomic mass (amu).
Find the amount of substance (mol) if the number of molecules is 1.806 · 10²³. Avogadro's number NA = 6.02 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
Find the amount of substance (mol) if the number of molecules is 15.05 · 10²⁴. NA = 6.02 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
Determine the amount of substance in 39.4 kg of gold (mol). µ = 197 g/mol.
How many moles of substance are in 9 g of water? µ = 18 g/mol.
Determine the amount of substance (mol) in 28.8 g of oxygen. µ = 32 · 10⁻³ kg/mol.
What is the mass of 5 mol of helium? µ = 4 g/mol.
What is the mass of 450 mol of oxygen (kg)? µ = 32 g/mol.
Find the mass of 5 mol of oxygen. The molar mass of oxygen is 32 · 10⁻³ kg/mol.
Compare the masses of tin and nickel ingots containing equal amounts of substance. The molar mass of tin is µt = 118.7 g/mol and that of nickel is µn = 58.7 g/mol.
Find the molar mass of butane (C4H10) (kg/mol). Ar(H) = 1 u, Ar(C) = 12 u, 1 u = 1.66 · 10⁻²⁷ kg.
Find the molar mass of nitric acid (HNO3) (kg/mol). Ar(H) = 1 u, Ar(N) = 14 u, Ar(O) = 16 u, 1 u = 1.66 · 10⁻²⁷ kg.
Determine the mass of three moles of copper sulfate (CuSO4) (g). Ar(O) = 16 u, Ar(Cu) = 64 u, Ar(S) = 32 u, 1 u = 1.66 · 10⁻²⁷ kg, NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
The mass of one gas molecule is 4.8 · 10⁻²⁶ kg. What is the molar mass of this gas (g/mol)? NA = 6.02 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
The molar mass of a substance is 36 g/mol. What is the mass of one molecule in kilograms? NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
The molar mass of nitrogen is 0.028 kg/mol. What is the mass of a nitrogen molecule (kg)? NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
180 g of water in a cup evaporates completely in one week. Estimate how many molecules on average evaporate from the cup each second. NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹, µ = 18 g/mol.
By mass, 84% of the gas in a vessel is nitrogen and 16% is oxygen. How many nitrogen molecules are there per oxygen molecule? MN = 28 g/mol, MO = 32 g/mol.

A layer of gold 1 μm thick was deposited on the surface of a device with a surface area of 20 cm². How many gold atoms are in the coating? NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹, the atomic mass of gold is 197 amu, and its density is 19.3 g/cm³.
Find the density of a metal (kg/m³) if the mass of one molecule is 6 · 10⁻²⁶ kg and the molecule concentration is 2.5 · 10²⁹ m⁻³.
In which substances is diffusion observed?
What is meant by Brownian motion?
answers: motion of solid particles placed in a liquid under the action of the liquid molecules.
motion of liquid molecules under the action of small particles placed in it.
motion of solid particles placed in a liquid resulting from their mutual interactions.

questions.text: The concentration of oxygen molecules in a vessel is n = 6 · 10²⁵ m⁻³. What is the density of the gas (kg/m³)? NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹, µ = 32 · 10⁻³ kg/mol.
320 g of oxygen occupies a volume of 0.02 m³. Find the molecule concentration (m⁻³). µ = 32 g/mol, NA = 6 · 10²³ mol⁻¹.
